scope_summary: Finish coat application for primed drywall CEILINGS in new construction, pre-trim phase. Assumes ceilings are already primed. Applies ceiling finish paint (typically flat white, 1-2 coats). NO edge work required - ceiling painter can roll into wall area because walls will be painted after and wall painter will establish the final ceiling line.
relevant_findings: NC production sequence: Prime all → Paint ceilings → Paint walls. Ceiling painter works first.
NO edge work at ceiling-wall boundary - walls haven't been painted yet and WILL be painted after
Ceiling painter can roll slightly onto wall area (1-2 inches) - wall painter covers this and establishes clean line
Edge work responsibility belongs in WALL paint spec, not ceiling spec
Spray+backroll is production standard for ceiling finish in NC
Overhead work is approximately 15-20% slower than equivalent wall work
18-inch roller standard for spray+backroll ceiling work
Flat or matte sheen typical for ceilings (hides imperfections, reduces glare)
Recessed lighting cans require protection from overspray
Ceiling electrical boxes (junction boxes, smoke detector locations) require protection
Window/door masking required - overspray fallout and roller splatter falls onto openings below
Window/door masking may already be in place from prime phase - verify intact or apply if missing
No floor protection needed (subfloor only in NC pre-trim)
Light sand between coats may be required for QT4 work

clarifications_from_field.rationale: Walls have NOT been painted yet and WILL be painted after ceilings. Wall painter establishes the final ceiling line. Ceiling painter can roll into wall area without concern for perfect line.
NC pre-trim has subfloor only. No finished flooring to protect.

clarifications_from_field.status: REQUIRED if not already in place
clarifications_from_field.rationale: Overspray fallout and roller splatter from ceiling work falls down onto windows/doors. Masking may already be in place from priming phase - if so, verify intact. If not in place, must be applied before ceiling painting.
This spec assumes ceilings are already primed (from SF_DRYWALL_FULL_NC_PRIME or similar).

prep_requirements.method: Pole sander with 220 grit, light pass to degloss and smooth
prep_requirements.reason: Improves adhesion and provides smooth base for finish coat

prep_requirements.method: Vacuum or tack cloth to remove sanding dust
prep_requirements.reason: Sanding dust causes adhesion issues and visible contamination

prep_requirements.method: Stuff cans with paper, tape over face, or use can covers
prep_requirements.reason: Prevent paint entering can, damaging trim or wiring

prep_requirements.method: Stuff with paper, tape over face
prep_requirements.reason: Prevent paint entering junction boxes, smoke detector locations

prep_requirements.method: Verify existing masking from prime phase is intact, or apply plastic film over openings and tape perimeter
prep_requirements.reason: Overspray fallout and roller splatter from ceiling work falls onto windows below
prep_requirements.skip_conditions: Required for spray methods; recommended for roll methods

prep_requirements.method: Verify existing masking from prime phase is intact, or apply plastic film and tape perimeter
prep_requirements.reason: Overspray fallout and roller splatter from ceiling work falls onto doors below
prep_requirements.skip_conditions: Required for spray methods; recommended for roll methods

advantages: Two coat coverage for color depth

limitations: Shows every imperfection - requires critical prep
Significant sheen application penalty on ceilings

standard.notes: Single coat of flat ceiling paint over properly primed surface is typically sufficient

premium_flat.notes: Two coats flat for colored ceilings or enhanced coverage. More thorough inspection than QT3. No sheen application penalty - flat is forgiving.

premium_eggshell.notes: Two coats for eggshell or satin finish. Light sand between coats. Sheen application penalty - more careful technique required on ceilings.

critical_semi_gloss.notes: Two coats for semi-gloss+ finish. Critical prep and inspection. Significant sheen application penalty - semi-gloss+ on ceilings is extremely demanding.

ceiling_to_wall_edge.reason: Walls not yet painted. Wall painter will establish ceiling line when painting walls. Ceiling painter can roll 1-2 inches onto wall area.

trim_edge.reason: Pre-trim phase - no crown molding installed

common_failure_modes.cause: Dry edge during rolling, inconsistent technique, working too slowly
common_failure_modes.prevention: Maintain wet edge, work in sections, consistent roller pressure, don't overwork
common_failure_modes.remediation: Additional coat may hide minor lap marks

common_failure_modes.cause: Roller nap too heavy, paint too thick, insufficient backroll
common_failure_modes.prevention: Use appropriate nap (3/8-1/2"), proper thinning if needed, thorough backroll

common_failure_modes.cause: Inconsistent coverage, spot repairs showing through
common_failure_modes.prevention: Uniform application, proper coverage rate, touch up wet-on-wet

common_failure_modes.cause: Insufficient coverage, paint spread too thin
common_failure_modes.prevention: Proper coverage rate, don't over-spread paint

required_paintscope_keys.required_when: Always - primary quantity driver for ceiling painting

required_paintscope_keys.required_when: Spray methods require ceiling fixture protection

required_paintscope_keys.description: Count of window openings to mask (or verify masking)
required_paintscope_keys.required_when: Spray methods; recommended for roll methods - overspray/splatter falls on windows

required_paintscope_keys.description: Count of door openings to mask (or verify masking)
required_paintscope_keys.required_when: Spray methods; recommended for roll methods - overspray/splatter falls on doors

recessed_lights_per_room.notes: Recessed cans per room in ceiling

ceiling_electrical_boxes_per_room.notes: Junction boxes, smoke detector locations, fan boxes per room

adjacency_notes.scope_impact: NO edge work - walls not yet painted. Ceiling painter can overlap onto wall area.
adjacency_notes.nc_context: Wall painter establishes final ceiling line. Edge work is in wall spec, not ceiling spec.

adjacency_notes.scope_impact: NOT applicable - trim not installed (pre-trim phase)
adjacency_notes.nc_context: Crown molding installed and painted separately after walls

notes_for_sop_librarian: Ceiling-only scope - no wall tasks, no edge work
Assumes ceilings already primed (not in this spec's scope)
Single coat standard (QT2-QT3); Two coats premium (QT4)
QT4 includes light sand between coats
Overhead work is slower than wall work - factor into rates
notes_for_estimation_engineer: Ceiling SF is the only surface quantity driver
Overhead work factor: ~15-20% slower than equivalent wall rates
No edge work labor - ceiling painter can roll into wall area
QT4 adds light sand between coats + second finish coat
Fixture protection uses room count heuristic (6 lights + 2 ceiling boxes per room avg)
assumptions: Ceilings are already primed (separate prime spec)
Standard ceiling heights 8-10 ft (adjust rates for higher ceilings)
Subfloor only - no finished flooring installed
Walls will be painted AFTER ceilings (wall painter establishes ceiling line)
Flat white or similar ceiling color (single color throughout)
uncertainties: Number of recessed lights per room varies by design
Whether one or two coats needed depends on primer quality and ceiling color
Impact of humidity on dry times between coats
